data.long_meaning: Jiya is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'ji' which means victory or triumph. In Hindu mythology, Jiya is the name of a goddess who is believed to bestow victory and success upon her devotees. The name Jiya carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jiya usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph over obstacles and challenges.
